DID YOU KNOW?

A club with a proud history.

Manchester United was founded in 1878 as Newton Heath and was renamed Manchester United in 1902. The club's colours are red, white and black.

ABOUT MANCHESTER UNITED
1878 Founded as Newton Heath
1902 Manchester United name adopted
1999 Historic Treble season
OT Old Trafford, Manchester
